# scripts/Visual/Lights/LightFixture.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../../scripts/Visual/Lights/LightFixture.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Torch burner with a GLB model and JSON recipe from assets/props/lights.
Recipes supply sockets, shared material slots, burner settings, glow/shadow parts, mounting, and wall soot.
Flames/corona attach to recipe sockets; glowing parts use instance parameters and char when extinguished.

Base: `not declared`. Registered class: `none`.
